title: Concept: go.mod replace points at a local directory
description: go.mod declares a `replace` whose target is a path on the build machine, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The build compiles whatever that directory holds, so the file on disk and the code that builds can differ with no manifest change.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through go.mod (go).
risk: The build compiles whatever that directory holds, so the file on disk and the code that builds can differ with no manifest change.
